response.sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) as order_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Orders) as share FROM Orders GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The database supports the NULLS LAST syntax (standard SQL, present in MySQL 8.0.14+, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle). For older MySQL versions, remove NULLS LAST if NULLs naturally sort last with DESC, or use ORDER BY CASE WHEN share IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, share DESC instead.
